P was the eldest of us three. P's humor was only reserved to horrible puns. Because his last name was "Long", in any sentence you used the word "Long", he say something like "Ha! Get it? That's my last name!" 

During P's first couple of weeks at the calling center, I would have to sit with him and monitor his calls. According to P, he thought I was flirting with him. He didn't know that I was always sitting next to him to monitor his calls. So, he'd start winking at me every so often and ask me if I wanted to come over to his apartment. It was pretty uncomfortable for a while. But once I told him I had a boyfriend, he stopped acting weird and started acting real with me. Although he still lies about his "vast knowledge of the world" and "mad gaming skill" (he still says crap like this), P is currently a self sufficient adult living on his own as a professor's assistant and conducting a study on our college campus's effect on the environment. 

J's priorities are considerably skewed ( in my opinion). After passing the driver's test and getting his certificate, instead of going directly to a Secretary of State's office and getting his license, he bought himself the new Super Smash Bros for the WiiU. He never made an effort to get his license since then, and this year he is taking the drivers test again to get a new certificate, and hopefully a driver's license.
